paper_record.title: Electron state tomography from quasiparticle interference maps
paper_record.abstract: Characterizing electronic band structures requires precise knowledge of wave functions and their quantum geometry. Here, we introduce a tomography method to reconstruct the density matrix of electron states from quasiparticle interference maps around single impurities. We consider two-orbital models on a honeycomb lattice, relevant to graphene heterostructures and direct-gap semiconductors. For on-site impurities, backscattering between time-reversed states directly maps the density matrix populations and coherences into distinct orbital contributions in the interference map. While local probes usually lack orbital resolution, these orbital contributions transform under distinct symmetry group representations and can thus be disentangled to reveal the density matrix and quantum geometric tensor of the scattering states. This establishes impurities as tomographic probes for band structures in scanning tunneling microscopy using conventional, unpolarized tips.

one_sentence_summary.zh: 利用常规不极化扫描隧道显微镜（STM）的准粒子干涉谱实现电子态密度矩阵和量子几何张量的层析成像。
one_sentence_summary.en: Reconstructing the electron density matrix and quantum geometric tensor from unpolarized STM quasiparticle interference maps using symmetry-based tomography.

problem.zh: 量子几何（如贝里曲率和量子度规）对固体物理至关重要，但实验测量极难，且常规STM探测器缺乏提取波函数轨道特征所需的轨道分辨率。
problem.en: Measuring quantum geometry (Berry curvature, quantum metric) is challenging because standard STM probes lack the orbital resolution required to extract the orbital character of wave functions.

approach.zh: 针对蜂窝晶格双轨道模型，利用单杂质散射产生的准粒子干涉（QPI）图，通过点群对称性（C3）分析将不极化的局域态密度信号分解为不同的轨道贡献，从而重构密度矩阵。
approach.en: For two-orbital honeycomb models, the method uses point-group symmetry (C3) to disentangle orbital contributions from unpolarized local density of states in QPI maps around a single impurity, enabling density matrix reconstruction.

main_takeaway.zh: 通过分析散射态在对称群表示下的变换特性，即使使用不带轨道分辨率的普通STM探针，也能从杂质散射图谱中完整提取电子态的量子几何信息。
main_takeaway.en: By exploiting the symmetry group representations of scattering states, the full quantum geometric information of electronic bands can be extracted from impurity-induced interference patterns using conventional, unpolarized STM tips.

why_it_matters.zh: 该方法为在石墨烯异质结和直接带隙半导体等实际材料中探测波函数的量子几何属性提供了一种通用的实验方案，无需复杂的极化探针技术。
why_it_matters.en: This method provides a practical experimental route to probe the quantum geometric properties of wave functions in real materials like graphene heterostructures and semiconductors without needing specialized polarized tips.

reason.zh: 提出了一种将常规STM测量转化为量子几何层析工具的新理论框架，极大地扩展了QPI技术的应用范围。
reason.en: It proposes a novel theoretical framework to turn standard STM measurements into a tomographic tool for quantum geometry, significantly expanding the utility of QPI techniques.

reason.zh: 论文采用了Letter格式，且针对凝聚态物理中的核心前沿问题（量子几何）提出了具有普适性的新方法。
reason.en: The paper follows the Letter format and introduces a broadly applicable new method for a core frontier problem in condensed matter physics (quantum geometry).
